trajectories.pathTitleVi: Canh tác truyền thống kết hợp công nghệ cơ bản
trajectories.shortDescription: Continue rice farming while utilizing basic mobile tools to track market prices and reduce middleman dependence.
trajectories.rationale: Keeps core income stable while slowly introducing efficiency tools.
trajectories.actionStepNow: Use your current smartphone or ask a family member to check daily rice prices online before selling.

trajectories.pathTitleVi: Nông nghiệp sạch và Giao dịch trực tiếp
trajectories.shortDescription: Transition part of your land or partner with neighbors to produce residue-safe rice and sell directly to small distributors.
trajectories.rationale: Meets growing consumer demand for clean food in Vietnam.
trajectories.actionStepNow: Identify one local farming technique to reduce chemical usage on a small test plot.

trajectories.pathTitleVi: Chủ chốt hợp tác xã nông nghiệp
trajectories.shortDescription: Take a leadership role in a local farming cooperative to aggregate produce and bargain collectively.
trajectories.rationale: Scales individual experience into collective bargaining power.
trajectories.actionStepNow: Speak with local agricultural extension officers about existing cooperative models in An Giang.
